mission.display_title: Generate RVs with the inverse transform method
mission.mission_purpose: Today's Mission exists to generate basic discrete and continuous random variables using the inverse transform method. So simulation rests on the Uniform→CDF inverse idea, without treating software black-box sampling as the whole LO.
mission.tutor_intent: Today I will force the candidate to state and apply inverse transform for at least one continuous and one discrete case at syllabus depth. And to refuse 'the software just samples' as a substitute for the method.
mission.educational_intent: Produce a cognitive move from 'distributions exist' to 'I can generate draws via inverse transform with a Uniform source.'
mission.learning_objective: Generate basic discrete and continuous random variables using the inverse transform method.
mission.concept_focus: U~Uniform(0,1) → invert CDF / use discrete inverse → generated draw; refuse black-box theatre.
mission.prior_bridge: Yesterday's Poisson process connection used families you already evaluate. Today applies generation method 2.1.5. Still topic 2.1.
mission.why_now: Inverse transform is the syllabus method LO before software-generation practice (2.1.6).
mission.expected_benefit: Study Progress for inverse transform. Not Topic Complete for 2.1.6 or 2.2.
mission.explainability: Assigned as Campaign Gamma Day 3 because 2.1.5 precedes software generation 2.1.6 in syllabus order.

knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: inverse transform steps
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. List the steps of the inverse transform method for a continuous random variable with CDF F. Name the Uniform source explicitly.
knowledge_checks.explanation: Method fluency requires naming Uniform and inverse CDF.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Draw U ~ Uniform(0,1). Set X = F^{-1}(U) (the quantile function). Then X has CDF F (under standard conditions).

knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: discrete case + refuse black-box
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. (1) In outline, how does inverse transform generate a basic discrete RV? (2) Refuse in one sentence: 'I do not need the method because software can sample.'
knowledge_checks.body: Discrete inverse via CDF thresholds; refuse black-box substitute for the LO.
hints: Use cumulative probabilities / threshold on U.
Syllabus requires the method, not only a sampler call.
knowledge_checks.explanation: 2.1.5 is method competence; software alone does not satisfy the LO.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: (1) Draw U~U(0,1); assign the discrete value whose CDF first exceeds U (inverse CDF / threshold rule). (2) Refuse: software sampling can implement the draw, but the LO requires understanding inverse transform. Not only calling a black box.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Only saying 'use rbinom' without inverse idea.
